mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or UNRATE rise > 0.5% does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% month-over-month signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or HOUST drop > 10% MoM does not correlate with subsequent demand weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over three months signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or INDPRO rise > 2% does not correlate with subsequent economic growth.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is negative, it signals a liquidity trap and economic stagnation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or the combination of low FEDFUNDS and negative GDPC1 growth does not correlate with subsequent market underperformance.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs per month for three consecutive months signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of instances despite positive signal, or PAYEMS increase > 200,000 jobs/month does not correlate with subsequent market outperformance.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by less than 1% YoY and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.3% in the same period, it signals a weakening consumer demand and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or the combination of weak RSAFS growth and rising UNRATE does not correlate with subsequent market underperformance.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) growth is negative for two consecutive months and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 3%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy in a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO growth < 0% for 2 months and FEDFUNDS > 3%
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or the combination of negative INDPRO growth and high FEDFUNDS does not correlate with subsequent market underperformance.
